correctness.rationale: Use the established monotone semiconjugacy and telescope its floor-series to binary mechanical Sturmian digits. Irrational rotation produces n+1 distinct length-n words, giving cylinder covers of diameter <=lambda^n/(1-lambda). Different words first differing at j<n have Euclidean separation >=lambda^j(1-2lambda)/(1-lambda) >=lambda^(n-1)(1-2lambda)/(1-lambda), strictly greater than scale r_n for lambda<1/3; proves exact equality and log N(r) coefficient. For bounded-type rotation, convergent denominators q_{k+1}<=(A+1)q_k control the largest partition arc O(1/n); pushforward of Haar gives cylinder masses <=C/n, and one-cylinder intersection yields µ(I)<=C/log(e/r). Mass distribution establishes positive h1 measure; (n+1)-cylinder covers give finite h1, zero hs for s>1 and infinity for s<1. Independent golden-ratio mechanical-word enumeration n=1,2,3,5,8,12,20,30 matched n+1 (finite diagnostics not an irrational all-depth proof).
